name: SandboxExecution

test_list.description: Tree and single-use receipt are checked before any sandbox side effect.
Actual exit, parsed tests, RTK issues and independent check determine completion.
Cancellation stops execution while journaled sandbox destruction remains owned.

inputs.name: review
inputs.description: Immutable explicit approval binding request, source tree, image and policy.

output_description: Durable execution/proof events and CAS artifacts, with sandbox destruction or a retained recovery locator.
